# Jetpack, replaying B down/up worked out by the host autopilot for seed 3 (~30 s), then nothing until a zapper.
# One character per 48 ms frame (1 = B down). The board must match the host: score 124.
# Scores aren't saved (dry run); frames move only with 'play'.

pick Jetpack
